scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix packages/shared && npm install --prefix apps/frontend && npm install --prefix apps/backend
scripts.dev: npm run prisma:generate --prefix apps/backend && npx concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix apps/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix apps/backend && npm run build --prefix apps/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm ci --prefix apps/backend && npm run build --prefix apps/backend
scripts.start: cd apps/backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/app.js
